about: Inputs and the answers the Python package gives for them. Written by tests/test_browser_fixtures.py --write; read by the browser runtime's tests and checked again by pytest.
synthetic: RGBA bytes, row-major, 4 per pixel. Row y has its own xorshift32 stream with initial state s = (seed + y * 0x9E3779B9) mod 2^32 (1 if that is 0). For each of the row's 4 * width bytes in order: s ^= (s << 13) mod 2^32; s ^= s >> 17; s ^= (s << 5) mod 2^32; byte = s >> 24. The alpha bytes are generated the same way and ignored.

preprocess.note: full128 of crops of one generated frame (box -> truncated edges -> tensor and its four looks), and of whole small images; tensor hashes are of float32 bytes, pool hashes of float64 bytes of a 16 x 12 grid (width x height), row-major, R G B per cell.

letterbox.note: the detector's canvas (BGR bytes, row-major) and input tensor (float32, channel first) for generated frames, on the 640 x 384 canvas padded with 114 and on one other canvas.

analysisSize.note: the size a picture is analyzed at. The last six heights fall exactly between two whole numbers and are rounded upward.

decode.note: raw detector rows (little-endian float32 bytes, in hexadecimal) and the detections cardvision.detect.decode gives for them, in frame pixels, best first.

cases.name: at the threshold, and a tie between classes

bank.note: a generated bank as encode_bank stores it, the float32 matrix decode_bank reads from it, and the look (best row, score, margin against another name) of generated unit queries.

identity.note: a generated catalog under each identity rule a catalog can state. keys: card id to identity key (Catalog.identity_of); two cards are the same card exactly when their keys are equal. banks: for a list of bank ids, the groups of two or more ids of one identity, each group's other members mapped to its representative, and the identities in the order the bank first shows them. refused: catalogs the printing rule refuses, naming the card, and the name rule accepts.

facets.note: the optional facets of a catalog (the labeling tool's filters). accepted: catalogs this package takes, with each declared facet (its values in chip order: declared, else numbers ascending and text in order of first appearance) and each card's values as lists. refused: catalogs it refuses, with fragments the refusal names (a facet's position or a card's id and facets.<key>).

accepted.what: values that set the type and the order

refused.what: a key with a capital first
a key ending in a line break
a value listed twice in values
values not of the stated type
a card's facets not an object
an undeclared key on a card
a text value for a number facet
a value outside the declared values
a value listed twice on a card
an empty list on a card
a true or false value on a card
an untyped facet given a number after text
facets on a card of a catalog that declares none

extra.note: a card's optional extra object, which nothing reads and every reader keeps. accepted: catalogs this package takes, with the extra of each card that gives one, as given. refused: catalogs it refuses (an extra that is not an object), with fragments the refusal names (the card's id and extra).

accepted.what: objects of any shape, and a card with none
an extra beside facets, a token and a card without art

art.note: cards without art ("art": null). accepted: catalogs this package takes, under each identity rule, with each card's art (null for a card without art), its identity key, the cards without art, and a bank of the cards with art only: its groups, representatives and identities, as for the identity section. refused: catalogs it refuses, with fragments the refusal names; a card must state "art", as a path or URL or as null.

refused.what: an art that is a number
an art that is a list

looks.note: four looks of a crop (score, margin), upright first, and the look the orientation rule chooses under an accept rule.

hover.note: generated face boxes of a frame and, per hover selection, the stack (bottom first) and what a pointer at each point resolves to: [index of the box hit or null, card id shown or null].

dhash.note: the frame fingerprint (cardvision.data.dhash) of generated images. images: the RGB of a generated RGBA image. ramps: (the RGB of a generated image, each byte divided by 4 and rounded down) + 96 + across * 12 * floor(9x / width) + down * 12 * floor(8y / height), cut to 0..255. halves: RGB bytes, row-major, of an image whose every second cell has a gray value of a whole number and a half and whose other cells have the gray it rounds to, halves to the even number. distances: pairs of fingerprints and the number of bits in which they differ.

events.note: a scoring run of the browser runtime on made-up inputs, and the events file it must write. manifest.lines: the manifest, one row a line. videos: the files given; frame k of a file is at k / rate seconds and has the fingerprint prints[k], or otherPrint; reportsFrameTimes false means the browser reports, for a frame, the time it was asked for. analysis: what the analysis of any kept frame finds, as the runtime's FrameAnalysis gives it (frame and boxes); the hover layer is the release's selection over these boxes. release and run: what the run's header is written from. lines: the events file, line for line, as the page must write it and as cardvision.evaluate.browser must read it.

geometricIndex.about: The toy index packed by cardvision pack-features: 'manifest' and the eight 'shards' (hex of each shard's bytes). 'cards' lists each card's unpacked descriptors (hex) and positions (the hex of their little-endian float32 bytes); 'knn' is each query's nearest and second nearest row over all rows (ties to the lowest row); 'votes' is GeometricStage.votes on it (ratio 0.8, waived for one identity or one image).

geometricAppend.about: The toy index of 'geometricIndex' packed in two steps, as cardvision pack-features --base does it: 'baseManifest' packs its first cards (for an older bank, shards named by content); 'manifest' adds the other cards in new shards and keeps the base's shards unchanged. 'shards' maps every shard path of both manifests to the hex of its bytes. The rows, in order, are the ones of 'geometricIndex', so the nearest rows and votes are the same.

paths.note: paths a release document may pin, and whether verify-release accepts each: a plain relative path that stays inside the document's folder as the URL parser reads it (no scheme prefix, backslash, control character, space at an end, absolute path, or segment that is or percent-encodes . or ..).
